headline: Is my soulmate waiting for me to heal?

voc.why: NO PULL RAN. Written 2026-08-20 from the money family's proven shape (cards-my-energy) and the standing soulmate bans, at the operator's direction ("write the beats first"). 🔴 HIGH PRIORITY — "heal" selects for trauma and mental-health disclosure, which Meta prohibits as a personal attribute. Pull before any spend.

note:
Test B — soulmate × keyword (2026-08-20). HEALING rung, BINARY. Keyword value +110%, n=410.

⚠ NO VOC PULL YET. Healing is the other rung I would pull before spend — 'heal' selects for trauma, abuse and mental-health disclosure, and Meta prohibits health as a personal attribute.

FRAME: no man. Must not fall through to decode-him.

🔴🔴 THE 'YES' IS THE MOST HARMFUL SENTENCE IN THIS TEST. 'Yes, he is waiting for you to heal' tells a woman that love is withheld pending her repair, by a person, indefinitely. Every shipped soulmate family already bans it (`you are not ready`, `you need to heal first` are pinned in BLAME_BANS as 'gates love on her fixing herself'). Banned outright, in every softened form.

🔴 AND THE 'NO' MUST NOT BECOME A RULING EITHER. 'You don't need to heal' is a verdict on her inner life from a stranger and it can land as dismissal on someone who knows she is hurt. The read does not grade whether she is healed. It refuses the WAITING, not the healing.

🔴 NO HEALTH, NO DIAGNOSIS, NO THERAPY LANGUAGE. No trauma, no attachment, no inner child, no nervous system, no shadow work, no 'do the work'. Meta-prohibited and outside what a card can say.

⚠ MUST NOT RESTATE `cards-heal-first`. That one answers the ORDER — whether there is a 'before' at all. This one answers WHO IS WAITING ON WHOM.

The finding: no. Nothing is standing still pending her repair — and she has been cast as the delay, most likely by advice she was given for free.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — nothing on that table is put away.
You asked if your soulmate is waiting for you to heal. Your hand went to the card where the work is already begun.
So no, dear. Nothing is standing still, waiting on you to be finished.
And there's no test on that table, dear. Nothing on it has to be passed.
But you've run your life as though there's one, dear. Yourself last.
That's why later is where things go, dear. Something taught you to wait your turn.
Let me look closer at what put you last in your own queue…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — he hangs by one foot and his face has no strain in it.
You asked if your soulmate is waiting for you to heal. Your hand went to the card that holds without struggling.
So no, dear. Nothing on this card is on hold, and nothing waits on you.
And this card is held and whole at the same time, dear.
But someone told you to be whole first, dear, and you believed it.
That's why you keep setting the bar further out, dear. It moves each time you near it.
Let me look closer at what keeps moving that bar…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — he steps off with his bundle still tied shut.
You asked if your soulmate is waiting for you to heal. Your hand went to the card that goes as it is.
So no, dear. Not one thing here is holding back until you're ready.
And the bundle isn't unpacked, dear. It goes with him, tied as it is.
But you've been unpacking yours first, dear. Before you'd let yourself go anywhere.
That's why the going never comes, dear. There's always one more thing in the bag.
Let me look closer at what's still in that bundle…
